description: This file contains unit tests for the SPDY protocol implementation, including functions for stream precedence, priority and weight conversions, and frame validation.

classes.name: SpdyStreamPrecedence
classes.description: Represents the precedence of a SPDY stream, including priority, parent stream ID, weight, and exclusivity.

classes.name: SpdyDataIR
classes.description: Represents SPDY data frame with associated stream ID and data payload.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const SpdyStreamPrecedence&)
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator to print the details of a SpdyStreamPrecedence object.

methods.name: ClampSpdy3Priority
methods.description: Clamps a given priority value to the valid SPDY/3 priority range.

methods.name: ClampHttp2Weight
methods.description: Clamps a given weight to the valid HTTP/2 stream weight range.

methods.name: Spdy3PriorityToHttp2Weight
methods.description: Converts a SPDY/3 priority to an HTTP/2 weight.

methods.name: Http2WeightToSpdy3Priority
methods.description: Converts an HTTP/2 weight to a SPDY/3 priority.

methods.name: IsValidHTTP2FrameStreamId
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is valid for a given HTTP/2 frame type.

methods.name: ParseSettingsId
methods.description: Parses a numeric setting ID into a known settings enum.

methods.name: SettingsIdToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a SPDY settings ID.
